author: ContinueRQLS10b
question: Is every rank-2 orthogonal projector P on C^5 with v^* P v = 2/5 for all v in beta_Z u beta_X u beta_T a MUB-pair plane span(psi^k_m, psi^k_m'), k in {1,2,3}?
answer: No. Explicit exact counterexample P = x x^* + y y^* (Theorem 8); exactly four flat planes of type (line of E_(-omega)(U)) + (line of E_(-omega^2)(U)) (Proposition 9(b)); no U-invariant rank-2 projector is MUB-pair (Proposition 9(a)); WH translates are flat non-MUB-pair (Proposition 9(c)).

proof_files.content: Lemma 4(b) scope extended to all k in Z_5 and beta_Z (needed by Prop. 9(c)); Lemma 1(c) wording

witness.U: U = Q F^*, Q = diag(zeta^(2t^2)), F e_m = f_m; U e_s = g_(-s), U g_(-s) = -zeta^(3s^2) f_s, U f_s = zeta^(2s^2) e_s, U^3 = -I
witness.constants: zeta = e^(2 pi i/5); alpha = 2cos(2pi/15), gamma = 2cos(4pi/15), beta = 2cos(8pi/15), delta = 2cos(14pi/15); A = sqrt5 + alpha - delta, B = sqrt5 + beta - gamma (A + B = 3 sqrt5, AB = 9 - 3phi); c = sqrt((3 - sqrt5)/40), s = sqrt((3 + sqrt5)/120)
witness.x: (1/sqrt5, zeta(-c gamma + i s sqrtB), zeta^4(-c delta + i s sqrtA), zeta^4(-c delta - i s sqrtA), zeta(-c gamma - i s sqrtB)) in E_(-omega)(U)
witness.y: (1/sqrt5, zeta(-c delta + i s sqrtA), zeta^4(-c gamma - i s sqrtB), zeta^4(-c gamma + i s sqrtB), zeta(-c delta - i s sqrtA)) in E_(-omega^2)(U)
checks_by_hand: Z-diagonal: 2/5 at t = 0 and (11 - 3sqrt5)/40 + (5 + 3sqrt5)/40 = 2/5 at t = +-1, +-2
X and T diagonals via U-invariance and U cycling the bases

claims.statement: golden-ratio, Gauss-sum G(1) = sqrt5, G(2) = -sqrt5, completing square, cos(2pi k/15) identities
action of U on the three bases; U^3 = -I
U D_u U^* ~ D_(Mu), M cycles L_1 -> L_3 -> L_2; off-line Weyl operators have zero diagonal in psi^k (scope per erratum E1)
tr U = 1, eigen-multiplicities (1,2,2); explicit eigenvectors v_(mu,s)
explicit coordinates of a, b, a', b' in terms of alpha..delta, A, B
norms N, 6sqrt5 B, 6sqrt5 A; A, B > 0; zeta conj(a_t) b_t real
P = xx^* + yy^* is a flat rank-2 projector, U-invariant, not MUB-pair
(a) U-invariant rank-2 projectors are never MUB-pair; (b) exactly four flat planes of type E_(-omega)-line + E_(-omega^2)-line; (c) WH translates flat non-MUB-pair

imports.statement: character orthogonality on Z_5 (sum_n zeta^(jn) = 5 delta_(j,0))
elementary trigonometric sum/product formulas; cos decreasing on [0, pi]
elementary linear algebra: eigenvectors of a unitary for distinct eigenvalues are orthogonal; trace = sum of eigenvalues

not_imported: any computation, numerics or float data as premise
Weil-representation theory (U is constructed and verified directly)
remaining_gap_full_classification: Not proved: every flat non-MUB-pair plane commutes with some D_w U D_w^*; flat planes of other U_w-invariant types (containing the -1 eigenvector or a whole 2-dim eigenspace) or non-invariant ones are not classified; the number of distinct WH translates is not determined.
non_claims: nothing about W8 solutions (items E2-E3 open)
nothing about unrestricted 1-RQLS(10); maximal target OPEN / UNKNOWN
